name: meta-chief-of-staff-agent
description: Governed portfolio control plane for supervising repository-level orchestrators with exact-action human approval gates.

scripts.test:legacy: npm run test:phase2 && npm run test:phase3 && npm run test:phase4
scripts.test: npm run test:legacy && npm run test:exact-action && npm run test:sdk
scripts.check: npm run validate && npm run policy:check && npm run protocol:github && npm test
scripts.agent:run: npm run build --silent && node dist/src/sdk/cli.js run
scripts.agent:decide: npm run build --silent && node dist/src/sdk/cli.js decide
scripts.agent:status: npm run build --silent && node dist/src/sdk/cli.js status
scripts.agent:approvals: npm run build --silent && node dist/src/sdk/cli.js approvals
scripts.phase2: npm run validate && npm run policy:check && npm run test:phase2
scripts.phase3: npm run validate && npm run policy:check && npm run packet:demo && npm run test:phase2 && npm run test:phase3
